tasks.goal: Greet the artist and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the artist and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Discuss tattoo design idea, size dimensions, and placement body area
tasks.hint: Explain your tattoo concept to artist.
tasks.done_when: Learner described tattoo design, size, and body placement.

tasks.goal: Inquire about artist hourly rate versus flat project price
tasks.hint: Ask artist for cost estimate.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about hourly rate vs flat project price.

tasks.goal: Ask about sterile needle hygiene procedures and single-use ink caps
tasks.hint: Inquire about health safety practices.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sterile needle and ink hygiene.
tasks.scene_hint: Buzzing tattoo machine sound mixes with antiseptic alcohol aroma in studio.

tasks.goal: Inquire about pain expectations for specific body placement
tasks.hint: Ask artist how painful placement will be.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about pain level expectations for tattoo area.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'sterilization'
tasks.hint: Sterilization is the process of making something free from bacteria or living microorganisms. Ask if metal grips undergo heat sterilization.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'sterilization'.

tasks.goal: Ask about recommended aftercare cream and healing schedule steps
tasks.hint: Inquire how to care for fresh tattoo.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about tattoo aftercare instructions and healing.

tasks.goal: Negotiate minor design stencil tweaks before finalizing artwork line draft
tasks.hint: Ask artist to adjust stencil outline.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested stencil design tweaks before tattooing.

tasks.goal: Ask if touch-up sessions are included free of charge within 6 months
tasks.hint: Inquire about touch-up policy.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about free touch-up session policies.

tasks.goal: Address concern regarding allergic reaction to red ink pigments
tasks.hint: Ask artist about organic ink options.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about ink allergies and organic alternatives.
tasks.scene_hint: Art portfolios showing fine-line and traditional tattoo flashes line studio walls.

tasks.goal: Ask how long session break intervals will take during long tattoo appointment
tasks.hint: Inquire about rest breaks.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about session breaks during tattooing.

tasks.goal: Confirm deposit payment required to reserve tattoo appointment date
tasks.hint: Verify deposit terms with artist.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed deposit payment terms.

tasks.goal: Request printed aftercare guide sheet and deposit receipt
tasks.hint: Ask for paper copy of instructions.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed aftercare guide and receipt.

tasks.goal: Verify accepted payment methods for final tattoo session balance
tasks.hint: Ask if cash or card is preferred.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified payment methods for final balance.

tasks.goal: Thank the artist and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the artist AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'layer'
tasks.hint: A layer is a quantity or sheet of material resting on a surface. Inquire how deep into skin layers the tattoo ink is applied.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'layer'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'coloration'
tasks.hint: Coloration is the natural appearance or shade of something. Ask about long-term skin coloration durability under sunlight.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'coloration'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'anesthetic'
tasks.hint: An anesthetic is a substance that induces insensitivity to pain. Ask if topical anesthetic numbing cream is available.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'anesthetic'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'surface'
tasks.hint: Surface is the outside part or uppermost layer of something. Ask how long outer skin surface healing takes after tattooing.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'surface'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about age verification and government photo ID requirements
tasks.hint: Ask artist what photo ID documents are needed before consultation.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about age verification and ID requirements.

tasks.goal: Ask if a companion or friend is permitted to sit in the booth during tattooing
tasks.hint: Inquire about visitor rules inside the tattooing area.

tasks.goal: Check artist availability for weekend session slots versus weekday mornings
tasks.hint: Inquire about booking calendar schedules.

tasks.goal: Confirm tipped percentage norms for custom artwork projects
tasks.hint: Ask artist about standard tipping practices in the studio.

tasks.goal: Inquire how to book follow-up shading appointment slot

tasks.goal: Request artist contact info for emergency aftercare questions

tasks.goal: Inquire about swimming, sauna, and heavy exercise restrictions during healing

tasks.goal: Ask how artist handles freckles or moles within tattoo boundary

tasks.goal: Inquire if single-use disposable razor heads are used for skin prep
